headline: Chilean Survey Shows 53% Assign Responsibility to AFPs for Pension Fund Losses
summary: A survey by Descifra showed that 53% of respondents place primary responsibility on pension managers (AFPs) for recent investment losses in conservative Fondo E portfolios. Over 80% expressed support for tighter regulations on funds near retirement.
why: Chile's private pension fund administrators manage over $150 billion in assets, forming a critical component of domestic capital markets.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Public criticism of pension fund performance increases political risk for legislative changes to Chile's pension system.
